'''Oakie Dokes''' was a [[Swokes Swokes/Legends|Swokes Swokes]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Artist/Legends|artist]] [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] to a [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|wealthy]] [[schinga]] breeding family on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]]. She came to the planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to represent her family's ranch in the [[Coruscant Livestock Exchange and Exhibition]]. Dokes's vanity led her emptying her family's [[Currency/Legends|savings]] account and, knowing her [[Oakie Dokes's parents|parents]] would be so disappointed they probably would not even eat her, stayed in the back alleys of Coruscant. There, Dokes discovered her talent of turning her feelings of loneliness into macabre and gory artwork. She achieved success and frequented Coruscant's [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]].  

On Coruscant in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], Dokes approached the wreckage of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]]'s [[Koro-2 all-environment exodrive airspeeder|airspeeder]] after a [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|failed assassination attempt]]. Dokes was at the Outlander Club shortly after. During another visit to the club, she was approached by the [[Con artist/Legends|con artists]] [[Dannl Faytonni/Legends|Dannl Faytonni]] and [[Achk Med-Beq/Legends|Achk Med-Beq]], who were interested in sponsoring her work. She trusted her heart and left the Outlander Club that evening with two new friends. 

==Biography==
===From privilege to destitution===
[[File:Coruscant-EotE.jpg|thumb|right|300px|Oakie Dokes came to the planet Coruscant (pictured) to represent her family's ranch in the Coruscant Livestock Exchange and Exhibition.]]
A privileged<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|I|195|Dokes, Oakie}}</ref> [[Gender/Legends|female]] member of the [[Swokes Swokes/Legends|Swokes Swokes]] [[Species/Legends|species]], Oakie Dokes was the [[Reproduction/Legends|firstborn]] child of a family of wealthy [[schinga]] breeders on the<ref name="db" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="GATORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref> [[Makem Te/Legends|Makem Te]]. Dokes's Dam sent her off planet to represent her family's ranch in the annual [[Coruscant Livestock Exchange and Exhibition]] on the<ref name="db" /> [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet<ref name="Complete Locations">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. On the metropolitan world, Dokes got in over her head as her vanity led to out of control [[Currency/Legends|spending]].<ref name="db" /> She squandered her fortune<ref name="CSWE" /> and emptied the family's [[Currency/Legends|saving]] accounts by purchasing troves of precious [[Gemstone/Legends|gems]] to implant into her body.<ref name="db" />

The destitute Swokes Swokes fled to the back alleys of Coruscant, knowing her [[Oakie Dokes's parents|parents]] would be so disappointed that they would probably not eat her.<ref name="db" /> She lived a [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credit]]-less life in the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|undercity]]<ref name="CSWE" /> gutters as she realized she had a priceless talent: the [[Artist/Legends|ability]] to transmute her feelings of loneliness into powerful art. Using similarly run-down [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]] dregs as her canvas and her paints, Dokes became a notable underground artist whose works were macabre, unsettling,<ref name="db" /> and gory.<ref name="CSWE" /> She achieved success, climbing the social ladder of Coruscant and reaching the strata that contained the<ref name="db" /> [[Nightclub/Legends|nightclub]] and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]] hall<ref name="CSWE2">{{CSWECite|II|431|Outlander Club}}</ref> known as the [[Outlander Club/Legends|Outlander Club]] in Coruscant's [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]].<ref name="db" /> Dokes frequented the nightclub during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]],<ref name="CSWE" /> which started in [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]].<ref name="Separatist Crisis">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'' dates the [[Raxus Address/Legends|Raxus Address]], which started the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]], to [[24 BBY/Legends|24 BBY]].</ref>

===Making friends===
[[File:Oakie_Dokes_Club.png|thumb|left|250px|Oakie Dokes spoke to a Human in the Outlander Club.]]
During a [[Local day/Legends|night]] in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> Dokes, alongside a crowd of people, approached the crashed<ref name="aotc">{{Film|II}}</ref> [[Koro-2 all-environment exodrive airspeeder|''Koro-2'' all-environment exodrive airspeeder]]<ref name="CCS">''[[Star Wars: Complete Cross-Sections]]''</ref> of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Zam Wesell/Legends|Zam Wesell]] in the entertainment district.<ref name="aotc" /> The bounty hunter, fleeing the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] after a [[Plot to assassinate Senator Amidala/Legends|failed assassination attempt]] on [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]], then left the wreckage and ran into the Outlander Club. Dokes was inside the Outlander Club when Wesell went in to hide, speaking to a [[Human/Legends|Human]] near the club's bar as the Jedi entered after her. When Wesell was disarmed by Kenobi with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], Dokes stayed near the bar and looked on as the bounty hunter was helped up by Kenobi. The Jedi then took Wesell outside and interrogated her.<ref name="aotc" /> 

At some point while visiting the club,<ref name="db" /> two [[Con artist/Legends|con artists]]<ref name="Faytonni">{{DB|character|lieutenantfaytonni|Faytonni, Lieutenant Dannl}}</ref> dressed in [[Republic Security Force/Legends|Republic miliary]] uniforms,<ref name="CSWE3">{{CSWECite|I|258|Faytonni, Dannl}}</ref> [[Dannl Faytonni/Legends|Dannl Faytonni]] and [[Achk Med-Beq/Legends|Achk Med-Beq]], approached Dokes, interested in sponsoring her future works. She was suspicious despite Faytonni's charm, as "mutual opportunity business partners" in [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]] sounded uncannily like a Swokes Swokes word for "suckers." Trusting her heart, Dokes left the Outlander that evening with two new friends that could serve as potential artistic subjects,<ref name="db" /> and an uneasy working relationship.<ref name="CSWE" /> She had interesting ideas about a composition of dismembered extremities draped in tattered Republic uniforms, though she had to wait until inspiration bit. Should the Swokes Swokes be pawned by the pair, the expensive gems implanted into her body were her reserves.<ref name="db" />

==Personality and traits==
Dokes was considered to be a swoon-worthy beauty<ref name="db" /> and to be beautiful in her own special way.<ref name="ImageAttack">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/explore/attack/2003/05/imageattack20030501.html|series=Image Attack|text=Oakie Dokes the Swokes Swokes}}</ref> Though she was thought of as physically attractive, Dokes had many more gifts beside that. After getting in over her head on Coruscant, her vanity left her destitute. While in the gutters of the planet, she realized she could turn her feelings of loneliness into art. Even though she was originally apprehensive of Faytonni's partnership, she trusted her heart and left the Outlander Club with two new friends&mdash;Faytonni and Achk Med-Beq.<ref name="db" /> Dokes, with her [[Color/Legends|gray]] skin, black<ref name="db" /> horns,<ref name="FF89">{{FactFile|89|GOR 1-2|Gragra the Gorgmonger}}</ref> and red [[Eye/Legends|eye]]<nowiki/>s,<ref name="db" /> was puffy and badly in need of orthodontics.<ref name="WhosWho">{{InsiderCite|75|Who's Who in the Outlander Club: It's Ladies' Night}}</ref>

==Equipment==
The Swokes Swokes had many expensive, precious gems implanted into her body.<ref name="db" /> During her visit to the Outlander Club<ref name="aotc" /> in 22 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]],<ref name="NEC" /> Dokes wore a black cocktail [[Clothing/Legends|dress]]<ref name="WhosWho" /> with a large collar.<ref name="aotc" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|A puffy nightmare badly in need of orthodontics, Oakie Dokes the Swokes Swokes is an arresting sight in her black cocktail dress.|Daniel Wallace|<ref name="WhosWho" />}}
[[File:Attack-Clones-Poster.jpg|thumb|right|250px|Oakie Dokes made one of her first appearances in ''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones''.]]
Oakie Dokes, portrayed by uncredited extra,<ref name="aotc" /> appeared in the [[prequel trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']],<ref name="aotc" /> in scenes shot at [[Fox Studios, Sydney]] on [[July 17]], [[2000]].<ref name="Mythmaking">''[[Mythmaking: Behind the Scenes of Attack of the Clones]]''</ref> On set, film director [[George Lucas]] joked that the character was the date of Dannl Faytonni, played by [[Anthony Daniels]].<ref name="ATBP" /> Dokes and other patrons of the Outlander Club were named by George Lucas and his film production company, [[Lucasfilm]], during the summer of 2000.<ref name="crc">{{SWArchive|url=episode-iv/bts/article/f20030502/index.html|text=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases|int=Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases}}</ref> The character's name is a rhyming affirmation with Swokes Swokes, which came from the wife of creature effects supervisor [[Nick Dudman]], [[Sue Oakes]].<ref name="WhosWho" /> 

Prior to the film's release, Dokes was first pictured in the documentary "[[Making Episode II Webdocs|A Twinkle Beyond Pluto]],"<ref name="ATBP">{{SW|url=video/a-twinkle-beyond-pluto|series=Making Episode II Webdocs|text=Part 5: A Twinkle Beyond Pluto}}</ref> released on [[July 31]], [[2001]].<ref name="ATBP Date">{{SWArchive|url=episode-ii/bts/me2/archive.html|text=''Making Episode II Webdocs'' archive}}</ref> Dokes then first appeared in the film alongside its [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (video game)|video game adaptation]],<ref name="GBA">[[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones (video game)|''Star Wars'': Episode II ''Attack of the Clones'']]</ref> both of which released on [[May 16]], [[2002]].<ref name="Year">''[[Star Wars Year By Year: A Visual History, New Edition]]''</ref><ref name="GBADate">{{WebCite|url=https://www.ign.com/articles/2002/05/15/star-wars-episode-ii-attack-of-the-clones-3|text=Star Wars Episode II: Attack of the Clones (GBA)|author=[https://www.ign.com/person/craig-ign Craig Harris]|date=2002-05-15|archivedate=20160325105351}}</ref> The character was first identified publicly on [[May 1]], [[2003]], though the [[Image Attack]] feature on [[StarWars.com]].<ref name="ImageAttack" /> An image in the [[May 5]], 2003, StarWars.com article "[[Cantina Roll-Call: Shedding Light on Some Alien Aliases]]" used the name "Okie Dokes" for the character and used a picture of<ref name="crc" /> a [[Senator/Legends|senator's]] [[Aide/Legends|aide]] from the [[1999]] prequel trilogy film [[Star Wars: Episode I The Phantom Menace|''Star Wars'': Episode I ''The Phantom Menace'']]<ref name="CTP">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref> to represent her.<ref name="crc" />

In the article "[[Who's Who in the Outlander Club: It's Ladies' Night]]", published in the [[Star Wars Insider 75|seventy-fifth]] issue of ''[[Star Wars Insider]]''<ref name="WhosWho" /> on [[April 6]], [[2004]],<ref name="SW.com">{{SWArchive|url=community/fanclub/mag/news20040315.html|text=The New Face of Evil}}</ref> author [[Daniel Wallace]] wrote that the character was a nightmare and an arresting sight in her dress.<ref name="WhosWho" /> The image of Oakie Dokes on the Image Attack inspired author [[Pablo Hidalgo]] to feature a Swokes Swokes in a similar position in his webcomic ''[[Rookies: Rendezvous]]'',<ref name="rendezvous">{{Blog|pablog|53|Rookies: Rendezvous -- Week Five Annotations|Fragments from the Mind's Eye|Pablo Hidalgo}}</ref> published between [[February 6]]<ref name="WeekOne">{{Blog|pablog|47|Rookies: Rendezvous -- Week One Annotations}}</ref> and [[May 10]], [[2006]].<ref name="Week13">{{Blog|pablog|70|Rookies: Rendezvous -- Week Thirteen Annotations -- Finale}}</ref> A StarWars.com [[Databank (original)|Databank]] entry for Oakie Dokes was written by the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] user "[[Grand Admiral Sean8]]", who elaborated upon her story through the Hyperspace feature, "[[What's The Story?]]."<ref name="db" /> The entry was posted on [[March 27]], [[2008]].<ref name="FansSetTheFacts">{{SWArchive|url=databank/updates/news20080321.html|text=What's the Story: The Fans Set the Facts}}</ref>
